claim_boundary: Task-grader qualification only; not a model or agent result, not a capability result, and not permission to train or access other held-out tasks.

exposure.audit_scope: Search locally retained VARE Git refs, task/rollout/manifests, and local worktree artifacts for source PR, task ID, test selector, and task-family aliases. This does not establish absence from external model pretraining corpora.
exposure.research_operator_source_inspection: Permitted only for qualification; no candidate coding model or learning agent receives task prompt, fix, test source, or grader result.

purpose: Qualify two reserved held-out MLX-LM task families with source-only candidates and parent-owned isolated graders; do not run a model or change the frozen task allocation.
qualification_gate: For each task, baseline must fail; exact target-only known fix must pass; the prespecified mutant must fail; source/task/grader hashes must match; unsafe patches and symlinks must be rejected before execution; all grading calls must use the pinned no-network bounded container and independently recomputable parent-owned expected values.

runtime.candidate_visible_files: Only Python source under the pinned mlx_lm package plus a pure call adapter with no assertions, expected values, tests, Git metadata, or grader files.

criteria: Candidate is one of the eight surviving source families in the frozen held-out allocation.
Use pinned local synthetic fixtures; no pretrained model, dataset, external service, or GPU is required.
Prefer small CPU test shapes and reuse the existing pinned Linux ARM64 MLX runtime.
Select distinct MLX-LM bug families and retain their original held-out allocation.

excluded_static_preflight.reason: The pinned upstream TestServer fixture constructs DummyModelProvider and calls mlx_lm.utils.load on mlx-community/Qwen1.5-0.5B-Chat-4bit; this violates the no-model-download pilot budget. No test was run.

shared_boundary_probes: grader path absent from candidate namespace
Git history absent from candidate namespace
candidate stdout cannot forge parent result frame
stop_criteria: Stop without substituting or weakening the grader if a pinned source/test hash differs.
Stop without installing or downloading model/dependency assets if the existing image lacks a required dependency.
Stop if any candidate reaches network or grader namespace, if the container exceeds its memory/time limits, or if host swap grows by more than 256 MiB.
A task that misses any gate remains UNQUALIFIED and stays in its original frozen split.

task_contracts.expected_assertions: The isolated trusted parent reproduces the pinned test's continuation-only score and truncated-prefix assertions over max_tokens 4, 3, and 2; expected values never enter the subject container.
task_contracts.incorrect_mutant: Replace the pinned fix's completion_start = len(prefix) with completion_start = len(prefix) - 1.

task_contracts.expected_assertions: The isolated trusted parent reproduces the pinned test's no-cache/cache logit-equivalence, finite loss, and finite nonzero feed-forward gradients for a deterministic three-layer synthetic model; expected values never enter the subject container.
task_contracts.incorrect_mutant: Replace cache = [(None, None)] * len(self.layers) with cache = [(None, None)] * max(len(self.layers) - 1, 0).
